SecureSH 0.1.10.

- RDP quality: force 32-bit true colour (was negotiating 16-bit → banded/washed-out).
- Vault: first-run setup now works — 'Set a master password' on first use instead of a dead 'Unlock' (you can finally save session passwords).

Includes everything from 0.1.9 (auto-updater, native RDP, WebRTC/H.264/JPEG Remote Desktop with system audio, Security panel). From 0.1.9 on, updates install automatically on launch.
